articles.title: Selma Blair’s representatives say she didn’t intend to hurt anyone on flight that led to her arrest
articles.summary: NEW YORK (AP) — Actor Selma Blair did not intend to harm anyone during a flight and its aftermath where she is alleged to have assaulted two flight attendants, a police officer and a nurse, according to a statement Friday from her representatives.

articles.title: Ontario set to import New York electricity this winter after Ford threatened to cut the U.S. off
articles.summary: Ontario has signed a contract to import 600 megawatts of electricity from New York state this winter to offset unspecified "facility maintenance," according to the Independent Electricity System Operator. The deal comes just weeks after Premier Doug Ford threatened to cut off electricity exports to the U.S. as retaliation in the ongoing trade war.

articles.title: York police identify suspect vehicle in fatal hit and run investigation in Vaughan
articles.summary: York police have identified a suspect vehicle they believe was involved in a hit and run that left a woman dead in Vaughan earlier this month.

articles.title: 31-year-old Toronto man arrested in Halifax, 1 suspect still wanted for North York homicide investigation

articles.title: Mississauga's leading candidates face off for final time, with focus on arts facility, police funding
articles.summary: Mississauga's leading mayoral candidates took a more collegial approach to Thursday's debate than in past face-offs, responding to a mix of challenging and light-hearted questions from residents.
